verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents Slack integration where the agent watches for @openhands mentions, opens a conversation using the message context, and replies in-thread when finished — directly matching the tag-to-delegate story — plus broader workflow triggers from GitHub/Linear/Slack. Missing for 10: evidence of sustained multi-turn thread discussion (not just single mention→reply), support for other chat tools (Teams/Discord), and independent/hands-on confirmation of the Slack flow.
